test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Every season the river overflows its banks and when it goes down it leaves silt for crops to be gruwn.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word** ‘gruwn’ **is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling of the word should be **‘grown’.**
 
• The sentence should read: ***“Every season the river overflows its banks and when it goes down it leaves silt for crops to be grown__.”***
 
• Correct spelling is crucial for clear communication and understanding.

Hence, the correct spelling is **'grown,'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Spelling errors can significantly alter the meaning of a sentence and can lead to miscommunication.
 
• It is always a good practice to proofread your writing to catch any spelling or grammatical errors.
 
• Utilize spell-check tools and resources to ensure your writing is error-free.
